name: YellowTradie
organization_description: YellowTradie makes a phone app that runs the whole job for a solo tradesperson.

software.name: YellowTradie
software.description: A phone app for UK solo electricians, plumbers and builders. It takes a message when a call is missed, turns speech into priced quote line items, sends PDF quotes and invoices, chases unpaid bills and keeps the figures for the quarterly tax return.
featureList: A message taken when you miss a call, written out and sent to you, with an automatic text back when the caller leaves nothing
One inbox for missed calls, messages and new leads
Voice to quote line items with your own rates
PDF quotes sent by text, WhatsApp or email
See when a quote was opened, approved or changed
Job diary with busy days and multi-day jobs
When a job overruns, the rest of the day worked out for you, with every customer's message ready to send
Photos, dictated notes and job costs
Invoices with deposits and part payments
Unpaid invoice chasing with a ready written message
Quarterly tax report with money in, money out and tax to set aside
VAT on quotes, invoices and receipts
A quarter spreadsheet for your accountant. Connections to Xero, QuickBooks and FreeAgent are being built

offers.description: £19.99 a month for everything in the app, one plan, no per-seat fee. 14-day free trial with a card needed to sign up. The app is not in the stores yet: join the list and we will tell you the day it opens.
